fixes.was: Mootness caused by settlement does not ordinarily justify vacating a federal civil judgment under review; vacatur is an equitable remedy available only in exceptional circumstances, and a settlement term calling for vacatur is not one.
fixes.now: Mootness caused by settlement does not ordinarily justify vacating a federal civil judgment under review; vacatur is an equitable remedy that a losing party who settles can obtain only in exceptional circumstances, and a settlement term calling for vacatur is not one.
